summary.text: Stefani Lord is a Republican state representative from New Mexico House District 22 who took office on January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lord lives in Sandia Park, New Mexico, and earned a B.S. in psychology from Portland State University in 2000.
Lord's career experience includes working as a manager and owning a business, and she founded Pro-Gun Women.
In the 2025-2026 session, Lord serves on the Consumer & Public Affairs Committee and the Local Government, Land Grants & Cultural Affairs Committee.
